hero.title: Visual Designer crafting meaningful visual identities and brand experiences.

about.paragraph1: I'm a visual designer who cares about how a brand feels before anyone reads a single word of it — the color, the type, the rhythm of a feed. My work spans identity systems, social media design, and the kind of digital detail that makes an experience feel considered rather than assembled.
about.paragraph2: An engineering background shaped how I think about the work — systems, structure, how pieces fit together — but design is where that thinking actually lives. Right now that means Sirat Platform and IEEE CUSB, and staying open to freelance and full-time work with teams who care about getting the details right.

sirat.description: Led visual identity and brand experience design for the Sirat platform, spanning branding, social media design, and digital touchpoints.

ieee-cusb.description: Directed graphic design and multimedia output for IEEE CUSB's student activities and events.
